chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinanī, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the man who forgets or assists (the borrower) and his wealth does not cease to remain as outstanding debts. How should he deal with his Zakat?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should purify it (pay Zakat), and he would not pay for what is upon him from the debts. But rather, the Zakat is upon the owner of the wealth'.
ai.seo_question: How is Zakat calculated when a person's wealth is tied up in outstanding debts?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that Zakat is an obligation on the net wealth held by the owner, distinct from the debtor's liability, thereby relieving the creditor of Zakat on the unpaid debt itself. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that Zakat is tied to possession and liquidity rather than mere claim, ensuring that the tax burden aligns with actual economic capacity. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the separation of asset-based obligations from personal debt in Islamic finance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the man who forgets or assists (the borrower) and his wealth does not cease to remain as outstanding debts. How should he deal with his Zakāt?’ Heasws said: ‘He should purify it (pay Zakāt), and he would not pay for what is upon him from the debts. But rather, the Zakāt is upon the owner of the wealth’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from ibn al- Sabbah al-Kinaniy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who does not collect what he has lent because of forgetfulness or the desire to help his borrowers so his assets continue to remain as loans.How must he deal with Zakat?
He (the owner of the assets) not the borrower pays Zakat.’”
